calls.statement:
WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
lines AS (
    SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, s.store_id, f.sale_date, w.dispatch_date, f.net_amount, f.etl_loaded_at,
           (s.store_id = 900) AS is_web
    FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT
 (SELECT SUM(net_amount) FROM lines WHERE NOT is_web AND sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27') AS store_sales,
 (SELECT SUM(net_amount) FROM lines WHERE is_web AND dispatch_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27') AS web_dispatched,
 (SELECT SUM(net_amount) FROM lines WHERE is_web AND dispatch_date IS NULL AND sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27') AS web_undispatched_in_period,
 (SELECT SUM(r.refund_net) FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27') AS returns,
 (SELECT SUM(net_sales) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27') AS control_all,
 (SELECT SUM(net_sales) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id<>999 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27') AS control_ex999,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-20' AND DATE '2026-10-05') AS dup_lines,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT return_line_id) FROM fact_return_line) AS dup_returns,
 (SELECT MAX(sale_date) FROM fact_sales_line) AS max_sale_date
